data.name: GOLDRUSHERS
data.detailed_description:
A Goldrush themed local multiplayer brawler for PC and Mac !


Play as two competing prospectors trying to fill your safes with precious gold nuggets or other items of value.
Whether it's in the dusty hills of the Sierra Nevada, the icy peaks of the Klondike, or the burning heat of the desert, it's your chance to strike it rich!

But beware, competing prospectors abound!
Armed with dynamite and bear traps and no sense of the law.

GOLDRUSHERS will provide fast paced action, wacky antics, and flying horses for your living room.

FEATURES

  • SPLIT-SCREEN MULTIPLAYER - Share a couch but steal the gold! Two players compete for one to three stages.
  • TWO-SCREEN MULTIPLAYER - We are in 2017! You can play GOLDRUSHERS on two screens for the ultimate experience!
  • THREE UNIQUE LEVELS - Choose from our 3 exotic locations with challenges to face and secrets to uncover!
  • MORE THAN 40 ITEMS TO FIND - Have you ever wondered how many dollars a snowman is worth? Just throw them in your safe and you'll find out!
  • DYNAMITE - Use dynamite to stun the other prospector and break into their safe - it's a blast!
  • BEARTRAPS - Hide beartraps and slow down the other player for an eternity!
  • FLYING HORSES - Throw them at the other player!

Notice: GOLDRUSHERS requires a controller and two players to play.

reviews.review:
[h1]Yeehaw! There's gold in them thar hills![/h1]

[h1]GOLDRUSHERS[/h1] 

Is a two person versus game. You go up against a friend and the two of you go at it grabbing up gold, emeralds, rubies and all sorts of other things. You can throw goats, horses, raccoons. And that's only a small sample of what goes on in this game.  The idea is to collect the most gold and toss it into your safe before your friend does.

[h1]Graphics[/h1] At the time of writing this review, I chose the fast option as the Best option the game had was slowing down my mac's performance to show said graphics.  Yes folks you read that right.  This game can be played on windows and Mac. The visuals themselves look very detailed, the maps themselves are fairly large and the different landscapes are nice. Score 7 out of 10.

I will make a couple of notes of observation to the developer of this game though.  1. During my second run through of the middle map at one particular point on the mountain, i somehow managed to get a fairly quick red-disruption on my entire screen. it lasted for a second but it was worth noting, it happened sometime during my jump at the mountain.

The other thing I'd like to make note of is this, In the game there is a particular flow of water, that goes completely straight it just hangs there in mid-air, that's an indicator of where the map's proverbial wall is, I'd offer the opinion to fix that minor detail so it transitions smoother with the rest of the map.

[h1]Sounds and Music[/h1] At the time of writing the first review it turns out that my headset was to blame for the lack of sound.  The sounds were crisp and clear and fun, the music was perfect for this type of game and i loved listening to every minute of it. It's the sort of stuff you'd expect to hear in the great old west days. 10 out of 10

[h1]Gameplay Fun and achievements[/h1] I have since found all the achievements in the game. That was real clever how you hid that unicorn!  The game would have been more fun with a pal, but me winning the whole game entirely by myself is also a lot of fun. I would say definitly don't buy this unless you have someone to play with.  For what it's worth, I like gold gathering/klondike style games and so i enjoyed myself.  I also decided to now increase my score of the overall fun because it took a lot of fun effort to get the unicorn so i'm adding an extra point to the original score i gave this game. 7 out of 10.

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1] I would have enjoyed seeing a few more maps, but i was satisfied with what there was.  I again would suggest this game to a person who has friends. This is not a single player experience (and while i like winning, i also like a challenge). But yes  I do recommend this game to play, but play it with a friend.


[quote] This review was submitted for [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/gaming_until_end]Gaming Until End[/url], through the generous contribution of [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/HellCowON]HellCow.[/url] [/quote]
